issues.evidence: spec.py DUPLICATE_COLUMNS assigns duplicate plans to region.Region_id (0.30) and storm.Dates_active / storm.Max_speed (0.30), but Region_id is a PRIMARY KEY and Max_speed/Dates_active are not flagged as duplicate columns in the atomic-operation groups (only group_sizes patterns). In values.py _init_sampler, dup_share is forced to 0.0 for pk_pos > 0, so the Region_id duplicate plan is silently overridden; the writer also deduplicates PK tuples. The duplicate plan for Max_speed/Dates_active is harmless but not required.
issues.requested_revision: No change strictly required: PK uniqueness is correctly preserved (integrity feedback shows pk_duplicates 0), and the extra duplicate plans do not violate any constraint. If desired, remove the Region_id entry from DUPLICATE_COLUMNS to avoid a dead parameter, and confirm Max_speed/Dates_active duplication is intentional.

issues.evidence: Execution feedback: nullable_columns shows every nullable column has generated NULLs (e.g. affected_region.Number_city_affected NULL 20/1343, region.Region_name NULL 18/265, storm.Name NULL 20/294). The NULL rule requires at least one NULL per nullable column and a share following the compact database; _plant_nulls plants max(1, round(share*n)) NULLs per nullable column, and spec.null_share returns 0.0 when the compact share is 0, so a single NULL is planted. This satisfies the interface rule.
